Murder at Valkenberg

By: Liz Fish | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
Martin Kennedy was a bipolar 34-year-old man admitted to Valkenberg Psychiatric Hospital to be stabilised after suffering a violent breakdown. He lived at home with his parents and had been struggling for many years with the condition. He had been admitted before to Valkenberg and successfully stabilised and released back home into his parents’ care. This time he didn’t return home. He was murdered.

Summary:
Martin was a highly functional person who was an actor and waiter and loved singing Karaoke. He was very social and had a close group of friends who were unaware that he had any mental instability. He managed his condition but sometimes needed to be admitted to get his meds right, but he was stable for 5 years at a time. He had been admitted to the male high care ward before and released after a month. This time when he went into Valkenberg he was refusing to take his medication. His parents were asked to buy him medication and deliver it to the Valkenberg pharmacy as the state hospital did not have this specific medication which dissolved quickly and would be more easily administered. They willingly did so but were not allowed in to see their son. A few days later, on Sunday morning they were told they could bring him some luxuries, but they had to leave them at the gate. Later that day they got a call from the hospital to say there had been an incident and their son had been attacked but he was OK, he just had a cut on his nose. They managed to call Martin and he was crying hysterically, and his throat was very hoarse so his father Derek could not make out much except Martin asked if his mother was missing him. His father is not sure if he was saying he was scared.

Further information:
Then on Monday 4th of October they got a call from Valkenberg asking if Derek and his wife would please come as soon as possible to the hospital. When they arrived they were informed their son was dead. Initially the doctor on duty Dr Reid lied to them saying sometimes when people take the medicine they were told to bring him they fall asleep and never wake up. They were given no further explanation and asked if they would like to see him. They were taken to a basement and Martin was lying on the floor ”like a dog” with a lot of blood which they said was when they had tried to resuscitate him. They were given no explanation and left.
Two weeks later after writing to everyone he could think of he was contacted by the Director of Specialised Hospitals in the Western Cape and asked if he would come to a meeting with the head of the hospital and head of the clinical unit. At this meeting they offered their condolences and said there would be an internal investigation, they would look at the security footage.
The SAP informed them a Detective Mathews would investigate the case, but several weeks went by and only when they started contacting Captain Kotze, his superior, were they informed that the state mortuary was doing tests. After his body was released to the private funeral parlour it was recalled and several more days went by. The police will tell them nothing, they say they will hand the case over to the state prosecutor but they will not let the family know the contents of the report, or the results from the test, or let them see the security footage. They say it’s up to the State prosecutor to make that call. All they know is that the person who attacked Martin has been assessed and declared fit to stand trail.
What the parents want to know is why was Martin not removed from the ward after he was attacked, he was a man of slight stature and was clearly vulnerable. They are haunted by the image of him lying on the floor covered in blood, (no attempt was to put him on a bed for the viewing.) They are wracked with guilt that they handed over their son to a psychiatric institution for care - could they have tried to deal with it themselves, and would he then still be alive?
It is now two month later and they still have no idea how their son was murdered, they have had no explanation from Valkenberg and the police say the Senior Prosecutor wants a forensic expert to look at the CCTV footage. Initially they were told that the person identified was still in Valkenberg and fit to stand trail. Valkenberg are not updating the parents.

Script: Martin Kennedy loved singing, it was something Kaylynn Sideris spent most weekends doing with him since they met 5 years ago.
Kaylynn: I was struggling with one of the songs because I got shy so then Martin saw I was struggling and he came next to me. He grabbed the mike and started singing with me just to try and give me that oomph. And then after that I bought a drink and I was like, you are my new friend,come and sit next to me
Masa: And it was a friendship made in karaoke heaven.
Kaylynn: We became friends from then and then they after every weekend we started seeing each other.
UPsound of doing the Jerusalema
Jason “ And his favourite song was Jerusalema and he could dance the whole choreography for that song. He would start dancing up and down here and everyone would join him and it would be whole vibe and everyone knew him like that.
Script: Close friend Jason Gardner says Martin was far more than just the life of the party
Jason “no matter what happened he would always be happy and supportive. Even if I was having the worst day he was always there and he would try and make you feel better
Script: That was how his parents Cheryl and Derek Kennedy, and his sister Tammy knew him, the son and brother who made them feel special, and of course let’s not forget Rocky his dog- who he was devoted to
Cheryl “ He always said virtually from when he could talk that he wanted to be an actor and that's what he did, and that's what he thrived at. He did his little odd jobs as a waiter in between. But yeah, that was his passion, and it's what he lived for.
Upsound Martin
Derek : 13:30:40:12 - Derek: singing at the top of his voice especially during lockdown. I mean, he used to come on this little balcony up there and he would give us, give us a song will make us happy for the day and things like that
Upsound singing
Script: But - there was a very troubled side to Martin, he suffered from bipolar mood disorder.
Masa: Did you know about his bipolar diagnosis?
Kaylynn: Yes, he told me because we used to go out socialising and he would never drink alcohol, and then he said to me, no I'm on medication. And he explained that to me,I would see his personality change quite quickly. And that was something I at first didn't understand, that's why when I could see his mood was going a certain way, generally i would pull myself a bit back I didnt want to get upset with him so rather pull back Kaylynn it is not his fault he is suffering from that
Masa “when did Martin's mental health issues start arising.
Cheryl: What happened was he was working at Tableview, and they were attacked and he was held up at gunpoint. And the doctor say the trauma of that caused the bipolar.
Script: He was 23. Over the next 10 years, he would be admitted to a specialised Psychiatric hospital 5 times, taking months at a time to stabilise him. But when he came out - he was well for years at a time.
LINK In September last year Martin had a relapse and became violent.
Cheryl: Like manic stages that come with quite a bit of aggression, but he didn't but he didn't really know what he was doing when he was in that state. It is a very difficult illness to deal with because you don't know what they thinking or what the reactions are going to be. And also for them because he didnt don't know what was happening to him or why and I think also frustrating for him.
Derek: It was actually quite scary 13:27:29:06 - He broke stuff around the house here. So we knew that it was out of control at that stage and we had to get him to the hospital the strength that they've got, you know, and it's frightening actually to see it, really is
Link: Martin had been admitted to Valkenberg Psychiatric hospital several times before for and discharged- this time he never came home
Script: The last 48 hours of Martin Kennedy’s life are shrouded in mystery. On Sunday the 3rd October after spending roughly 10 days in the male high care ward
Derek: I got a phone call to say that there's been an incident. He was he was attacked and um, they had called the doctor,
Masa: Attacked by who .
Derek: They just don't tell you who or what at around about 6pm We got a phone call again to say, the doctor's been. They think everything's okay. He's just got a little cut on his nose and everything's fine.
Script: It was now late on Sunday, and because of the pandemic they were denied a visit. The next morning- Derek managed to speak to Martin .
Derek: It sounded like you've been screaming for four months nonstop. He was croaky. I couldn't hear a word, he said. What oh, what I thought of it was in saying help. And then the and then the last thing he said to me, which could fathom out was , is my mom missing me?
Script: Leaving them deeply disturbed and filled with questions - what was happening with Martin?. That afternoon they got the call.
Derek 13:37:35:16 there's been an incident you need to fetch your wife and come through to the hospital.
Script: As they rushed to the hospital they tried to work out why they both had to go in. They hoped it was to sign a consent form, to move him out of danger- instead, they were greeted with the news that the staff hadn’t been able to rouse Martin after the afternoon sleep - their son was dead.
Derek: Cheryl was devastated. Cheryl was in a state that I thought she was going to have a nervous breakdown
Script: At the time the staff had no idea why he had died, but the doctor on duty speculated that possibly, Martin had died from the medication, which the parents had been asked to supply, as the State pharmacy didn’t have stock. Then - they were asked if they wanted to see his body
Derek: The worst part about it Masa, is that he was left on the floor like a little animal. Could they're not just pick him up and put him on the bed. Just clean it up a little bit, she said the blood splattered was from the drips that they try to administer to get him up to the tracks with half an hour to give him mouth to mouth resuscitation and things like it, which never worked . Every time I close my eyes, I can see him lying on the floor there like a little dog.
Script: Then the next morning they received a further call - the hospital now suspected foul play, after viewing the CCTV footage. Once it became a criminal investigation it was like being cast off into the abyss
Link: For two weeks after that shocking site of seeing their son lying dead on the floor they were left wondering. Derek Kennedy wrote to everyone authority he could think of- finally Valkenberg Psychiatric hospital agreed to a meeting
Script: Dr Qhama Cossie head of acute service at Valkenberg, apologised for the trauma it caused the parents to see Martin dead on the floor.
Qhama: What happened is that when we do a resuscitation, we need to do it on a hard surface, but when the resuscitation failed, at that point, it became an unnatural death. And at that point, we are aware that we mustn't tamper with anything in the area. And that's when we called the police to come and start the investigation
Script: In his 16 years at Valkenberg nothing like this has ever happened. 6 people have died over the last two years- some of natural causes, and others have committed suicide, from hoarding their medication.
Masa “The day before Martin's death, his parents were called and told that he was assaulted by a fellow patient. Their question is why wasn't he removed when it was clear that he was a target?
Dr Cossie - Martin was very unwell and and very restless and very disruptive to the rest of the people in the ward as part of his illness. And there was an incident where there was an altercation which was initiated by him, where he pushed another patient who retaliated and punched him. So the person that Martin had the interaction with on the weekend, they were separated. It's not the same individual that we are worried, maybe involved in the death.

Masa They still don't know that you've done an investigation and what was the outcome of that. They still don't know what is in that CCTV footage, they have been deprived of that.
Qhama: I think the difficulty in this in this case is there's there's a there's a police investigation that's currently ongoing and as a hospital, we do not know any more information than that.
Masa: Are they any suspects?
Qhama: So our initial investigation showed that there may be another person, another patient implicated. And that's the information was handed over to the police, which includes CCTV footage
Script: What exactly was captured on those cameras - how many people were involved - who is covering whose back? Or is it just too difficult to identify the exact moment - and what action - by which person - led to his death
Cheryl: the 1st thing you want to know is how and why. And because they've got this security footage why aren’t they able to see it. So that we can make our own opinion on what happened. At end of the day you want just closure, you know? You just don’t want that not to happen to anybody else or ever again.
Derek for such a devastating incident to take his life. You know I can understand if he was if he was murdered in the street. But murdered in a hospital under health care workers. But it just blew my mind.
Jason He went to a place where it's supposed to be able to take to get you on the right track, you know? So it was very shocking, it's the last thing you expect from that?
Masa: Someone sitting at home with a family member who has mental illness challenges and thinking is this a safe place to bring my loved one. Are you capable of taking care looking after them and making sure that the security here
Qhama: Security, we do in different ways….. we try and manage risk with medication….What we also do is multiple observations from different kinds of people. So there will be group activities throughout the day where patients are monitored and assessed by different people . They'll be nursing staff in the wards. And then there's also security personnel in the wards who have an assessment of the day
Script: The case is now entirely in the hands of the police, who appear to have bungled several steps. First, it took 3 weeks for them to return to the scene of the crime, to take pictures. Martin's body was released from the state mortuary, only to be recalled, because insufficient tests were done. Then, having been told they’d identified a perpetrator who was fit to stand trial, the State prosecutor now says she wants expert facial recognition opinion, on the CCTV footage. But worse still, Martin’s parents are being denied the autopsy results.
Derek The policeman keeps on telling me that he's got 600 files. I just need to know what's going on. Is somebody going to be held liable and responsible for my son's death?

Script: We tried to get the police to account for the state of the investigation, but they refused an interview, saying it was premature, and that the ongoing case, was at a sensitive stage ”
LINK: It’s now months later and Martin's family are still has no answers- neither the police nor the staff at Valkenberg Psychiatric hospital can shed any light on what happened. Who committed the crime or when or if it will ever go to court
Cossie …..I don't want to say there was a murder because at this point we don't know what's happened, because if we did know what happened, we would communicate it. And I think that, you know, the anxiety and the distress is caused by that. We don't know what happened yet sa yet.
Kaylynn: How can you put somebody to rest when you don't know the real story as to why they are dead?
Derek: We were friends, we weren't dad and son, we were mates. We did everything together.
Cheryl: I miss the closeness of him always being there, and it was also very protective of me. you know it made me feel special.
Derek 13:57:08:17 - I still want him to walk through the door
Kaylynn “My heart has not come to terms that Martin has gone yet”

metadata.Unique Selling Point: Martin Kennedy was a bipolar 34-year-old man admitted to Valkenberg Psychiatric Hospital to be stabilised after suffering a violent breakdown. He lived at home with his parents and had been struggling for many years with the condition. He had been admitted before to Valkenberg and successfully stabilised and released back home into his parents’ care. This time he didn’t return home. He was murdered.
metadata.Summary: Martin was a highly functional person who was an actor and waiter and loved singing Karaoke. He was very social and had a close group of friends who were unaware that he had any mental instability. He managed his condition but sometimes needed to be admitted to get his meds right, but he was stable for 5 years at a time. He had been admitted to the male high care ward before and released after a month. This time when he went into Valkenberg he was refusing to take his medication. His parents were asked to buy him medication and deliver it to the Valkenberg pharmacy as the state hospital did not have this specific medication which dissolved quickly and would be more easily administered. They willingly did so but were not allowed in to see their son. A few days later, on Sunday morning they were told they could bring him some luxuries, but they had to leave them at the gate. Later that day they got a call from the hospital to say there had been an incident and their son had been attacked but he was OK, he just had a cut on his nose. They managed to call Martin and he was crying hysterically, and his throat was very hoarse so his father Derek could not make out much except Martin asked if his mother was missing him. His father is not sure if he was saying he was scared.
metadata.Further information: Then on Monday 4th of October they got a call from Valkenberg asking if Derek and his wife would please come as soon as possible to the hospital. When they arrived they were informed their son was dead. Initially the doctor on duty Dr Reid lied to them saying sometimes when people take the medicine they were told to bring him they fall asleep and never wake up. They were given no further explanation and asked if they would like to see him. They were taken to a basement and Martin was lying on the floor ”like a dog” with a lot of blood which they said was when they had tried to resuscitate him. They were given no explanation and left. Two weeks later after writing to everyone he could think of he was contacted by the Director of Specialised Hospitals in the Western Cape and asked if he would come to a meeting with the head of the hospital and head of the clinical unit. At this meeting they offered their condolences and said there would be an internal investigation, they would look at the security footage. The SAP informed them a Detective Mathews would investigate the case, but several weeks went by and only when they started contacting Captain Kotze, his superior, were they informed that the state mortuary was doing tests. After his body was released to the private funeral parlour it was recalled and several more days went by. The police will tell them nothing, they say they will hand the case over to the state prosecutor but they will not let the family know the contents of the report, or the results from the test, or let them see the security footage. They say it’s up to the State prosecutor to make that call. All they know is that the person who attacked Martin has been assessed and declared fit to stand trail. What the parents want to know is why was Martin not removed from the ward after he was attacked, he was a man of slight stature and was clearly vulnerable. They are haunted by the image of him lying on the floor covered in blood, (no attempt was to put him on a bed for the viewing.) They are wracked with guilt that they handed over their son to a psychiatric institution for care - could they have tried to deal with it themselves, and would he then still be alive? It is now two month later and they still have no idea how their son was murdered, they have had no explanation from Valkenberg and the police say the Senior Prosecutor wants a forensic expert to look at the CCTV footage. Initially they were told that the person identified was still in Valkenberg and fit to stand trail. Valkenberg are not updating the parents.
